busy_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The BUSY pin. Defaults to not connected.

*See also: [Waveshare E-Paper Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/waveshare_epaper#configuration-variables)*

full_update_every.docs:
**int**: E-Paper displays have two modes of switching to the next image: A partial update that only changes the pixels that have changed and a full update mode that first clears the entire display and then re-draws the image. The former is much quicker and nicer, but every so often a full update needs to happen because artifacts accumulate. On the `1.54in`, `1.54inv2`, `2.13in`, `2.13inv2`, `2.90in`, `2.90inv2`, `7.50inV2p` and `gdew029t5` models, you have the option to only do a full-redraw every x-th time using this option. Defaults to `30` on the described models and a full update for all other models.

*See also: [Waveshare E-Paper Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/waveshare_epaper#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.

*See also: [Waveshare E-Paper Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/waveshare_epaper#configuration-variables)*

2.13inv2.docs: 2.13in V2 display (Pico e-Paper 2.13v2 and Cloud Module)

gdew029t5.docs: GooDisplay GDEW029T5, as used on the AdaFruit MagTag and Pimoroni Badger

2.70in.docs: currently not working with the HAT Rev 2.1 version

gdey029t94.docs: GooDisplay GDEY029t94, as used in the monochrome 2.9inch display from seeedstudio

2.90inv2-r2.docs: 2.9in V2 display, but with different initialization and full/partial display refresh management than `2.90inv2`

7.30in-f.docs: 7.3in 7-color display (black, white, red, yellow, blue, green, and orange)

7.50in-bc.docs: display with version sticker '(C)' on the back, B/W rendering only

7.50in-hd-b.docs: Can't use with an ESP8266 as it runs out of RAM

2.13in-ttgo-dke.docs: T5_V2.3 with DKE group display (DEPG0213BN) tested

1.54in-m5coreink-m09.docs: GoodDisplay gdew0154m09, as used in the M5Stack Core Ink

13.3in-k.docs: 13.3in, with the K model, 960x680, B/W rendering only

model.docs:
The model of the E-Paper display. Options are:

*See also: [Waveshare E-Paper Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/waveshare_epaper#configuration-variables)*

reset_duration.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: Duration for the display reset operation. Defaults to `200ms`. Setting this value to `2ms` may resolve issues with newer e-Paper Driver modules (e.g. Rev 2.1).

*See also: [Waveshare E-Paper Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/waveshare_epaper#configuration-variables)*

reset_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The RESET pin. Defaults to not connected. Make sure you pull this pin high (by connecting it to 3.3V with a resistor) if not connected to a GPIO pin. The 2.13" B74 and V2 display variants require the reset pin.

*See also: [Waveshare E-Paper Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/waveshare_epaper#configuration-variables)*

spi_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the [SPI Component](https://esphome.io/components/spi) if you want to use multiple SPI buses.

*See also: [Waveshare E-Paper Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/waveshare_epaper#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to re-draw the screen. Defaults to `1s`, use `never` to only manually update the screen via `component.update`.

*See also: [Waveshare E-Paper Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/waveshare_epaper#configuration-variables)*

rotation.docs:
Set the rotation of the display. Everything you draw in `lambda:` will be rotated by this option. One of `0°` (default), `90°`, `180°`, `270°`.

*See also: [Waveshare E-Paper Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/waveshare_epaper#configuration-variables)*

lambda.docs:
**[lambda](https://esphome.io/automations/templates#config-lambda)**: The lambda to use for rendering the content on the display. See [Display Rendering Engine](https://esphome.io/components/display#display-engine) for more information.

*See also: [Waveshare E-Paper Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/waveshare_epaper#configuration-variables)*

pages.docs:
**list**: Show pages instead of a single lambda. See [Display Pages](https://esphome.io/components/display#display-pages).

*See also: [Waveshare E-Paper Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/waveshare_epaper#configuration-variables)*
